official_bath_facts_seen.room_bath: Guest-room bath/tub axis is part of every room's private hot spring bathing experience; room names include stone-garden and sky open-air styles.
official_bath_facts_seen.room_open_air_bath: Official site and Google/OTA surfaces state every room has open-air/semi-open-air bath using source-flow Dogo Onsen.
official_bath_facts_seen.public_bath: JTB states no large public bath at this lodging. Reviews mentioning hotel bath or large bath are treated as sister-facility/external route unless clearly in-room.
official_bath_facts_seen.private_bath: JTB labels family/private bath available; in context this appears to refer to private room-bath style, but record as official wording only and do not merge with family bath reviews.
official_bath_facts_seen.family_bath: JTB official wording says 家族風呂あり/貸切可, but details are unclear; requires operation recheck.
official_bath_facts_seen.source_claims: Official/JTB: all rooms source-flow Dogo Onsen / 生湯 / 源泉かけ流し.
official_bath_facts_seen.spring_quality: JTB: simple spring; other detailed pH/source temperature not found in this pass.
official_bath_facts_seen.use_time: Some reviews note source flow stops late night; official operating time not found in this pass.
